Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to utilize a plurality of similarity metrics including at least one metric based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the current step is determined using a combination of user input and the computed alignment.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on a visual cue that indicates the current step.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the next step is determined using a combination of user input and the computed alignment.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on a visual cue that indicates the next step.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, including user interface elements that correspond to the documented actions.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, including analyzing the captured images to identify user actions.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, including feedback from the user regarding the effectiveness of the alignment.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the extraction is based on user-defined criteria.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the current step is determined using a combination of user input and the computed alignment.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on a visual cue that indicates the current step.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the next step is determined using a combination of user input and the computed alignment.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on a visual cue that indicates the next step.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, including user interface elements that correspond to the documented actions.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, including analyzing the captured images to identify user actions.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, including feedback from the user regarding the effectiveness of the alignment.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extraction is based on user-defined criteria.
